svg.title: Gateway overhead
svg.desc: Horizontal bars of the p50 and p95 latency pii-guard adds per request for each mode, concurrency and streaming setting, and stacked bars of where the p50 overhead goes.
svg.text: Latency pii-guard adds to an LLM call (total minus upstream), mock upstream with a fixed delay
Overhead per request: p50 bar, p95 tick
Where it goes (p50, c=1, not streamed)
Fixture set 'latency-corpus' (hand-written, fictional hu/en/de messages), a new session per request, mock upstream delay 50 ms; c = concurrent requests.
Overhead = gateway total - time waiting on the upstream; 'other' = untimed work (HTTP, scheduling). Hardware: Apple M1 Max, 10 CPUs, local loopback.
